acceptanceCriteria: Drafts exclude files changed by the diff and bookkeeping paths (.taskman/, docs/BUILD-LOG.md, build-log entries).
A focused test on a diff touching those paths produces a usable draft.
body: Residual from lane cem-1022r (PR beamfall/corvint#1550, seal dbc8920d4). The draft citation plan cites files the diff itself touches and paths such as .taskman/ and docs/BUILD-LOG.md, so lanes cannot use it as-is (the lane's first dogfood try failed citation-plan-uniform).
title: dogfood propose-citations drafts cite the diff's own files and bookkeeping paths
